newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar, bonds show modest moves on data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar, bonds show modest moves on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds showed only modest movements after official statistics showed March quarter capital expenditure rose 6.5 percent.
Median forecasts had centred on a 3.5 percent rise after a 2.4 percent fall in the December quarter.

Also in the report was the second estimate for expected capital expenditure in 1997/98, put at A$36.57 billion compared with a first estimate of A$31.90 billion (revised from A$34.68 billion). The dollar was quoted at US$0.7655/60 compared with US$0.7654/59 just before the data while the June 10-year bond futures contract was at 92.455 against a pre-data 92.430.
